newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss overnight hotel stays fall in summer period.
newsitem.headline: Swiss overnight hotel stays fall in summer period.

text.p: Overnight stays in Swiss hotels declined 4.5 percent in the summer quarter June-August from the same period last year, the sixth quarterly decline in a row, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Overnight hotel stays were down 451,000 from a year ago to 9.65 million, a statistics office statement said.
It said mediocre summer weather had helped push down hotel stays by Swiss and foreign guests in all three months.
Visits by Swiss travellers fell 2.8 percent to 3.72 million in the period.
Hotel stays by foreigners fell 5.5 percent to 5.93 million, led by a strong 7.9 percent decline in visits by Europeans to 4.07 million.
